description: OpenCode native windows and the CK the OpenCode plugin encodes from each (opencode-transform-adapter.ts encodeOpenCodeWindowToCk). The daemon's OpenCode codec derives the same CK from `messages` after removing only its ordinals and block identity stamps (crates/daemon/src/codec/opencode.rs). Each refusal records the code and text the daemon answers the window with on either path. Regenerate with EIDNARA_WRITE_OPENCODE_CODEC_PARITY=1: first `bun test opencode-codec-parity` for `expected`, then `cargo nextest run -p daemon -E 'test(a_malformed_opencode_window)'` for each `refusal`.
